result.title: TensorLOB: Structure-Preserving Tensor Learning for Limit Order Book Forecasting
result.summary: The limit order book (LOB) records outstanding buy and sell orders across multiple price levels. Its state evolves over time across market side, price level, and order attribute, naturally forming a multiway structure. However, existing LOB models typically flatten these dimensions into a matrix model, thus obscuring the existing structural relationships. Starting from first principles and the market-microstructure intuition of the LOB, we design TensorLOB to operate entirely in the tensor domain. TensorLOB uses mode-wise tensor contractions for feature extraction and directly contracts the learned representation with low-rank class-weight tensors for prediction, retaining the distinct roles of time, side, level, and attribute modes. Experiments on the FI-2010 benchmark show that TensorLOB achieves the highest accuracy, recall, and F1 score across all four evaluated horizons. This proof of concept highlights the potential of high-dimensional modelling of multi-way latent information intrinsic to financial markets, which has so far been largely overlooked.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TensorLOB，完全在张量域中建模限价订单簿：用逐 mode 张量收缩提取特征，并将学到的表示与低秩类权张量直接收缩以做预测，在 FI-2010 四个预测期上取得更高准确率、召回率与 F1。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不展平、显式保留时间/方向/价位等多维结构」的低秩张量表示思路，可能为 LVR 中如何组织视觉细节、深度与位置等多维 latent 状态提供表示几何层面的概念参照，是否可迁移尚待核查。
